title: クイーンSの後に・絶対！

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't you know it?! I came in first! The spectators even gave me a warm round of applause!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Looks like I finally showed the real me on the track, so I'm feeling pretty proud of myself! Now I just gotta take this energy into the Shuka Sho!
